summary: Backend-facing contract and dispatch tables. expsys_base defines the ExpressionSystem class (composition of all Substrait/extension expression-system protocols) with register_expression_system and get_expression_system; function_keys/enums.py holds the FKEY_* enums; function_mapping holds ExpressionFunctionDef definitions, the ExpressionFunctionRegistry, lowering declarations and projection output rules. Also owns backends/expression_systems/base.py (BaseExpressionSystem ABC).
key_classes: ExpressionSystem — abstract backend base composed from all expression-system protocols
ExpressionFunctionDef — registry entry mapping function key to Substrait metadata and backend method
ExpressionFunctionRegistry — lookup of function definitions by key
BaseExpressionSystem — ABC in backends/expression_systems/base.py shared by backends
FKEY_SUBSTRAIT_* / FKEY_MOUNTAINASH_* enums — type-safe operation keys
key_functions: register_expression_system(backend) — decorator registering a backend system
get_expression_system(backend) — fetch the registered system class
extension_points: Add FunctionDef entries in function_mapping/definitions.py (~3000 lines) for new operations
lifecycle_notes: backend detection moved to mountainash.core.backend_detection (relations-dispatch-parity spec); re-exported here for compatibility
risks: Role split between this module and function_mapping/EXPRESSION_TYPE_REFERENCE.md must stay current
Backend alias handling lives in core.backend_detection, not here
